description: 관세청_항구 공항별 수출입실적(GW) [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 관세청. 강원도가 강원특별자치도로 변경('23. 6. 11. )됨에 따라 참고자료에 강원특별자치도의 시도코드( 51)를 추가 반영하였습니다. ※ '26. 7. 1. 자 전남광주통합,인천 지방행정체계 개편으로. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
